scope: Rice evidence expansion: prioritized, question-mapped verification and synthesis tasks

gaps.title: Source accuracy before reuse
gaps.work: Correct source summaries through primary verification and trace dependent records; preserve unresolved access separately. Resolve the separately recorded arithmetic, species, basis, category and attribution flags in source-summary-audit.json; distinguish internal inconsistency from a primary-verified correction.
gaps.acceptance: Each disputed statement has a source locator, recorded correction or explicit unresolved disposition; no disputed value enters a public synthesis.
gaps.status: planned; not represented as a completed evidence gap
gaps.dependency_rule: Holds apply to affected claims or combinations; continue unaffected verified work in parallel
gaps.next_artifact: Claim-level correction/hold ledger linked to canonical source and dependent synthesis/evidence records

gaps.title: Primary access and identity
gaps.work: Resolve declared raw paths and public originals; preserve accessible versions and hashes; adjudicate the 16 mechanical bulk records and publication versions.
gaps.acceptance: Every potentially eligible record has an accessible verified original or an explicit access-blocked record. Mechanical extraction is never counted as completed scientific curation.
gaps.status: planned; not represented as a completed evidence gap
gaps.dependency_rule: Holds apply to affected claims or combinations; continue unaffected verified work in parallel

gaps.title: Study/dataset family overlap
gaps.work: Trace FDA sampling releases, risk reports, CR reuse, global compilations, review-included studies and related field reports to independent experimental/sample families. Include EFSA/Meyer reuse, NHBCS infant-cohort overlap, selected high-As/speciation compilations and programme-versus-sampled-farm counts.
gaps.acceptance: Study, report, food sample, composite, repeated season and analyte counts remain distinct; no duplicate contribution enters a quantitative synthesis.
gaps.status: planned; not represented as a completed evidence gap
gaps.dependency_rule: Holds apply to affected claims or combinations; continue unaffected verified work in parallel

gaps.title: Full question-specific eligibility and search
gaps.work: Screen the 319 local candidates with exact material/species/question criteria; use review bibliographies to find missing primary reports, then run reproducible external searches for each synthesis question. Explicitly follow up original studies cited for puffed-rice thiolation/storage and analytical conversion in EFSA 2024 (Colina Blanco 2024; Dai 2022); reconcile their exact identities against the owned corpus before a request.
gaps.acceptance: All local candidates receive inclusion, contextual, duplicate, inapplicable or access-blocked dispositions; external-search limits and dates are recorded. Local inventory completion is not literature-search completion.
gaps.status: planned; not represented as a completed evidence gap
gaps.dependency_rule: Holds apply to affected claims or combinations; continue unaffected verified work in parallel

gaps.title: Occurrence beyond the selected FDA frame
gaps.work: Reconcile global/regional grain data, arsenic and mercury species, co-metals, food form, date, market/origin, analytical validation and censoring before comparison. Preserve Song’s 19,786-rice subset apart from all-food totals, selected high-tAs samples apart from representative sampling, and simulated iAs fractions apart from direct speciation.
gaps.acceptance: A reader can distinguish historical retail grain, field cultivars, contaminated sites, cooked composites and finished products, with original statistics and analyte-specific uncertainty.
gaps.status: planned; not represented as a completed evidence gap
gaps.dependency_rule: Holds apply to affected claims or combinations; continue unaffected verified work in parallel

gaps.title: Mechanisms and intervention transfer
gaps.work: Compare soil/redox/microbial/cultivar mechanisms and controls using harvested-grain evidence, comparator, independent units and exact scale. Extract paired absolute residual concentrations and uncertainty; compare Sun’s field persistence, Liang’s pot effects, Jiang’s residual Cd/yield and Gupta’s null metal response without ranking maximum percentages.
gaps.acceptance: Each proposed control identifies demonstrated endpoint, settings, adverse/null effects, nutrient/yield/resource trade-offs and validation needs; no seedling or laboratory result becomes commercial efficacy.
gaps.status: planned; not represented as a completed evidence gap
gaps.dependency_rule: Holds apply to affected claims or combinations; continue unaffected verified work in parallel

gaps.title: Exposure and health integration
gaps.work: Separate food content, digestion models, biomarkers, modeled intake/hazard and observed health outcomes; appraise confounding, attrition and population relevance. Include null urinary-As thickener findings, pregnancy physiology, respiratory outcomes, rice-plus-water attribution and observational Se/Cd contexts; obtain adjusted effects and cohort-family links.
gaps.acceptance: Outcome estimates and uncertainty are extracted where supportable; null results and observational limitations remain visible; no hazard quotient or in-vitro result becomes a clinical outcome.
gaps.status: planned; not represented as a completed evidence gap
gaps.dependency_rule: Holds apply to affected claims or combinations; continue unaffected verified work in parallel

gaps.title: Material and product boundaries
gaps.work: Expand grain-fraction and derivative evidence through the existing ingredient/product destinations; retain Rice as the parent scientific synthesis. Prioritize direct protein, syrup, formula, flour and beverage observations; distinguish EFSA model-derived commodity values from measured products and Gu cereal nonmeasurement from low measured iAs.
gaps.acceptance: Each derivative/finished-product claim points to the measured material, preparation and basis. Ingredient values are not assigned automatically to syrup, protein, flour, cereals or beverages.
gaps.status: planned; not represented as a completed evidence gap
gaps.dependency_rule: Holds apply to affected claims or combinations; continue unaffected verified work in parallel

gaps.title: Scientific narrative and generator contract
gaps.work: Develop multi-source narratives by evidence theme, not a one-paragraph-per-question quota. Reconcile prose, tables, methods and the full citation ledger.
gaps.acceptance: Sections explain convergence, disagreement, causal limits and practical implications. Every used source is cited, including source contributions originating in tables; unreviewed catalogue entries are not dressed as included studies.
gaps.status: planned; not represented as a completed evidence gap
gaps.dependency_rule: Holds apply to affected claims or combinations; continue unaffected verified work in parallel

gaps.title: Current legal and authority context
gaps.work: Check exact current instruments and toxicology updates for species, form, intended use, jurisdiction and dates.
gaps.acceptance: Legal/value types, dates, provisions and basis are traceable; no adjacent-category or historical value is presented as a universal current rice limit. Certification values remain outside this task.
gaps.status: planned; not represented as a completed evidence gap
gaps.dependency_rule: Holds apply to affected claims or combinations; continue unaffected verified work in parallel

gaps.title: Decision-relevant commercial evidence
gaps.work: Search specifically for lot heterogeneity, supplier monitoring, field replication, processing validation, cost, sensory/nutritional effects and waste handling. Assess the existing Li integrated-governance lead before concluding commercial implementation evidence is missing; require sampled-unit and baseline verification.
gaps.acceptance: Review states distinguish not-yet-extracted, inaccessible, conflicting, insufficient and searched-with-no-eligible-evidence. Any decision scenario states its assumptions and verification needs.
gaps.status: planned; not represented as a completed evidence gap
gaps.dependency_rule: Holds apply to affected claims or combinations; continue unaffected verified work in parallel

gaps.title: Review standard and update propagation
gaps.work: Use question-appropriate appraisal and synthesis, document exploratory amendments, organize independent scientific/methodological review and source-triggered corrections.
gaps.acceptance: No completed/systematic-review label from layout, citations, file counts or tests. Dependencies, review attribution, search dates and reasons for conclusion changes are inspectable.
gaps.status: planned; not represented as a completed evidence gap
gaps.dependency_rule: Holds apply to affected claims or combinations; continue unaffected verified work in parallel

gaps.title: Organoarsenic and transformation synthesis
gaps.work: Compare DMA(V), MMA(V), thiolated forms, heating/storage and method interconversion using the EFSA 2024 assessment, its originals and grain measurements.
gaps.acceptance: Direct versus derived occurrence, elemental versus compound units, censored values, processing assumptions, storage time, analytical conversion, toxicology limits and reused formula samples are explicitly separated.
gaps.status: planned; not represented as a completed evidence gap
gaps.dependency_rule: Resolve affected claims before promotion; unaffected verified work can proceed
gaps.next_artifact: Organoarsenic and transformation synthesis extraction/applicability table with exact primary locators

gaps.title: Experimental units and matched control effects
gaps.work: Resolve paired versus unmatched washing, polishing, year and treatment comparisons; preserve lot/plot/farm versus analytical replicate counts.
gaps.acceptance: Every reduction claim has a defined comparator, independent unit, starting/residual measurement and basis. TatahMentan nine-washed/nineteen-unwashed grouping is verified before causal removal wording; no analytical replicate becomes another independent product.
gaps.status: planned; not represented as a completed evidence gap
gaps.dependency_rule: Resolve affected claims before promotion; unaffected verified work can proceed
gaps.next_artifact: Experimental units and matched control effects extraction/applicability table with exact primary locators

gaps.title: Integrated field implementation
gaps.work: Verify Li’s regional pH/cultivar/water/amendment programme against exact original identity, sampling, baseline, scale and measured outcomes.
gaps.acceptance: Programme reach is distinguished from sampled hectares/farms/lots; baseline and residual grain Cd with uncertainty, co-contaminants, yield, costs and persistence are extracted or explicitly unavailable. No bundle effect is assigned to one component.
gaps.status: planned; not represented as a completed evidence gap
gaps.dependency_rule: Resolve affected claims before promotion; unaffected verified work can proceed
gaps.next_artifact: Integrated field implementation extraction/applicability table with exact primary locators

gaps.title: Species preservation and screening fitness
gaps.gap_type: analytical validity for the intended decision
gaps.work: Compare species recovery before/after extraction, holding time and matrix effects; reconcile rice-only screening agreement and natural-sample findings.
gaps.acceptance: Rice Cr(VI) nondetection is bounded by tested material/limit/stability; spike-only findings stay outside occurrence. Portable method bias and false pass/fail performance are assessed without inferring equivalence from correlation or turning sample cleanup into food remediation.
gaps.status: planned; not represented as a completed evidence gap
gaps.dependency_rule: Resolve affected claims before promotion; unaffected verified work can proceed
gaps.next_artifact: Species preservation and screening fitness extraction/applicability table with exact primary locators
